_: The values, as data. The reasoning is in GUIDE.md; this file is the same facts in a form a build can read. Nothing here is code: a printer, a designer and a stylesheet all read the same numbers.

color._: Eight roles. Each has a day value and a night value; nothing else changes between themes. Ground and ink swap; the accents lift enough to read. Every text role passes 4.5:1 on its ground in both themes.

ground.use: Page and surface background; the tile.

sky.use: Accent; the second nibble. Links, statuses, focus.

sage.use: Marks and surfaces only. 2.9:1 on Alkali — never text.

sage-text.use: Sage where it must carry words.

geometry._: Both forms of the mark are built from these numbers and nothing else, in one unit. The bite's centre is given in the bitten cell's own coordinates.

forms._: How the numbers compose. Coordinates are derived from geometry, not stated here.

type._: One family at two optical sizes. The wordmark is always the lowercase name in the display cut.

scale._: Ratio 10/7 — cell to seam — from a 16px base.

space._: The seam unit at 4px. Every step is one of the mark's own numbers.

copy._: The words the brand ships with. The voice rules that produced them are in GUIDE.md.
copy.name: snackbyte
copy.headline: Software that knows where it ends.
copy.subhead: snackbyte builds tools for people who need something that does not exist yet. Each one does one job, knows only what it needs, and stops there.

theme._: How an implementation selects between day and night.
theme.dark: prefers-color-scheme: dark, unless html[data-theme="light"]; always under html[data-theme="dark"]
